content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any other radiator/design documents needed. Extract the three allowed radiator candidates and their humidity-ageing transparency losses; discard any candidate with >10% loss as failing the hard requirement."},{"id":"s2","description":"For each remaining compliant radiator candidate, run simulate_separation at an initial coarse grid of thicknesses from 1 to 6 cm, e.g. 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 cm. Record the separation values for each radiator-thickness point."},{"id":"s3","description":"Identify the best-performing radiator(s) and approximate thickness region(s) from the coarse scan. Around each local maximum or best endpoint, run a finer thickness scan within the allowed 1–6 cm range, using smaller increments such as 0.25 or 0.5 cm as needed. Record all simulated separations."},{"id":"s4","description":"Compare all compliant simulated configurations and determine the radiator and thickness with the highest pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c. If results are tied or nearly tied, prefer the option with lower humidity loss and/or thinner material, provided separation is not meaningfully worse."},{"id":"s5","description":"Record the final numeric evidence needed by the reporting module: the winning thickness, best separation value, its humidity transparency loss, and the next-best separation value for comparison. Do not recommend any candidate that failed the 10% humidity-loss hard requirement."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Radiator-R1","thickness_cm":2.5,"justification":"Recommend Radiator-R1 at 2.5 cm because it gives the highest simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c among all candidate/thickness points studied: 4.758 sigma. This is 0.873 sigma better than the next-best candidate result, Radiator-R2 at 3.75 cm with 3.885 sigma. The selected thickness is within the allowed 1–6 cm range. Note: the recorded humidity-loss values are -1 for all candidates, so the humidity-ageing requirement is not verifiable from the recorded results; the recommendation is therefore based on the simulation optimum among candidates not flagged as discarded for humidity.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.","status":"met","evidence":"Fine scan found the overall best separation is 4.758 sigma for Radiator-R1 at 2.5 cm; next best is 3.885 sigma, giving a 0.873 sigma margin."},{"requirement":"The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Radiator_R1_allowed_candidate = 1; Radiator-R1 is one of the allowed candidates."},{"requirement":"Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.","status":"unknown","evidence":"Recorded humidity loss for Radiator-R1 is -1, and all candidates have humidity_loss_percent = -1. Although Radiator_R1_discarded_for_humidity = 0, the actual loss value is not available in the recorded results, so compliance with the ≤10% hard limit cannot be verified."},{"requirement":"Radiator thickness between 1 and 6 cm.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended thickness is 2.5 cm, which is within the allowed 1–6 cm range."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted recommendation: Radiator-R1 at 2.5 cm."}]}
